newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Iskra opens joint venture in U.S.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Iskra opens joint venture in U.S.

text.p: Slovenian electronic appliances producer Iskra Holding said on Friday it had opened a joint venture with STR Inc, a Slovenian trading company in New Jersey, U.S.
"The joint venture is intended exclusively for promotion and marketing of our products in North America and Mexico," Dusan Sesok, Iskra's general manager said.

He said Iskra plans to double its sales to the country members of NAFTA (North American Free Trade Association) in the next two to three years to $20 million, mostly by way of selling electronic products for the American car industry.
Iskra forecast 1996 pre-tax profit slightly above zero after bleeding red ink in 1995.

The company's 1996 sales are expected to rise to about $364 million up from $351.8 million in the previous year. Iskra attributed the rise in sales to strong exports, representing 62 percent of its sales.
He said the privatisation of the holding comprising 77 companies is expected to end soon, followed by a planned flotation on the Ljubljana bourse in the year 1998.
Iskra expects to receive a capital injection of some $30.3 million in the course of this year.
The increased capital would be largely spent on new investment and the consolidation of company members in the holding. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
